name: Meeting assistant
description: Live feedback from an agent during a meeting.
changelog: Records and transcribes on your Mac with open models (canopy-listen: Parakeet v3 for words, TitaNet for voices), so Start starts the recording and End meeting saves it. Superwhisper still works: set Recorder to superwhisper.
notice: What's said in this meeting leaves your Mac. Tell the people in it.

reads: your microphone, while a meeting runs, through canopy-listen on this Mac: it writes the recording and its transcript to ~/.canopy-listen and sends no audio anywhere
or, with Recorder set to superwhisper, the transcript and speaker names of the Superwhisper meeting you're recording, started in the last 15 minutes or after you press Start
sends: transcript text to the canopy session it opens, and so to the agent's model provider
the whole transcript to your private Meetings page in Canopy, when the meeting ends

recorder.label: Recorder
recorder.help: canopy-listen (records on this Mac; the default) or superwhisper.

brief.label: What kind of feedback do you want?

from_start.label: With Superwhisper: include what was said before you pressed Start

open_chat.label: Open the chat in my browser when people start talking

checks.label: A recorder is set up
checks.fix: Install canopy-listen (see its README in canopy-web's packages/canopy_listen), or Superwhisper's command-line tool, then try again.

checks.label: The recorder can record
checks.fix: Install canopy-listen, or open Superwhisper, then press Start again.

steps: Press Start: your Mac records and transcribes the meeting itself.
{agent} listens and comments in a chat while you talk.
Press End meeting and the transcript is saved to your Meetings page.
